usageNotes: Invalidates the current session ticket, effectively logging out the authenticated user. No parameters are required — the session is identified by the Authorization header or cookie present in the request. Call this when a management session is complete to avoid leaving active credentials on the server.
destructiveReason: Permanently invalidates the active session ticket, requiring re-authentication for any further API access.
tips: Returns null on success — a 200 with an empty/null body is expected and correct.
API token-based callers are not affected by session expiry, but calling this endpoint with a token still succeeds (no-op on the token itself).
If the ticket is already expired or invalid, the endpoint may still return 200 — do not rely on an error response to detect double-logout.
